message: Add an A/B test to conditionally show/hide the testimonial on the welcome upgrade page to measure its impact on conversions. This test introduces a `welcome-testimonial` feature flag with 'control' (show testimonial) and 'hidden' (hide testimonial) variants. --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * The Welcome Upgrade page now supports a feature-flagged Testimonial section. Depending on rollout, some users will see the testimonial while others won’t, enabling targeted experiments. * Default behavior remains unchanged for most users; no impact on navigation or upgrade flows. * No user action required.
